title: The little piano Nat Cole played
summary: She bought a piano on installments as soon as she got the Dunbar job; Nat Cole played it and she still has it.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Any of this ever happened. As a matter of fact, the little piano that I have in my den today, Nat used to play on that piano. All the guys, because I bought that little piano when I first came here, when I very first came to California. I needed a piano, and I told my aunt, I said, 'I've got to get a piano.' So just as soon as I got a little job at the Dunbar I went on down and bought myself a piano, you know. I paid $5.00 down and $5.00 a month on it, you know. And I'm sure my aunt must have stood for it because I didn't have any established credit. Well, they weren't that hot about credit then, you know. But anyway, that very little piano that I have in my den today, it was a small piano and in later years, something like yours, I had it cut down. I had it modernized later, you know.
But Nat used to play on that piano. So I really got a big, big charge out of telling people, 'Well, Nat King Cole played on my piano.'
